releaseNotes: feat(widget): Implement widget refresher and store management
changelog: Added WidgetRefresher to handle refreshing of widget data and server metrics.
Introduced WidgetStore for managing widget configurations, metrics, and snapshots using DataStore.
Created WidgetUi for UI components and actions related to the widget.
Added drawable resources for widget icons and indicators.
Defined XML layouts for widget configurations.
Implemented unit tests for WidgetLogic to ensure correct functionality.
